name: academic-research-skills
description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize
one_liner: A set of pre-built instructions that walks an AI assistant through writing an academic paper end to end — research, draft, review, revise, and finalize.
buyer: A PhD student or postdoc who needs to produce publication-ready papers faster without hiring an editor.
business_use_cases: A university writing center licenses it to grad students as part of a paid 'AI research accelerator' workshop series.
A freelance academic editor uses it as a first-pass drafting and formatting tool before doing paid human polish, cutting their turnaround time in half.
A small research lab standardizes every trainee on the same skill set so papers come out in consistent journal-ready format.

money_ideas.idea: Run paid cohort-based workshops teaching grad students to set this up and use it for their thesis or papers.
Offer a premium, curated skill pack tuned for a specific field (e.g. biomedical journals) as a one-time purchase.

steal_this: Build a 'first draft to submission' service for grad students: they send raw notes and data, you run this skill pipeline plus one round of human review, and charge per paper.
